title: Western Star 6964 4800 4900 Powder Coated Road Train FUPS compliant Road Train Custom Built Bullbar #22
description: Western Star 6964 hi-tensile powder coated aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Five post design with the 100mm wide main box uprights extended to the bottom of the main channel to the Cow catcher fitted with five small uprights. Road Train signs with WS covers, Built with 88mm diameter pipe. Custom driving light mounts (4) as requested, Combination LED indicator/park repeater lights are also fitted. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin and powder coated protector plate. Front mudflap bar standard. Spring assist to raise and lower the bar.
